name: Twitch Chat
author: Plinth
description: Live Twitch chat for any channel, via Twitch's official chat embed. Accepts a channel name or any twitch.tv link; the chat follows the panel's light or dark theme, or keeps one of its own.

properties.name: theme
properties.label: Chat theme
properties.help: auto follows the panel: a light theme gets Twitch's light chat and a dark one its dark chat, switching when the theme does. dark or light keeps that one whatever the panel shows.
